name: KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Cross (shaders)
idioms: compiler regression shaders: every stage, #version 310 to 460, many extensions
subgroup, ray-query and buffer-reference code, preprocessor-heavy
user functions with in, out and inout parameters and array parameters
notes: The sparse pattern keeps shaders/ and drops the SPIR-V assembly (*.asm.*) and deliberately invalid (*.invalid.*) files; about 306 GLSL files remain, while 97 files under shaders/ are SPIR-V assembly that use the stage extensions (.asm.vert and the like), which no GLSL dialect reads and the pattern excludes (disclosed in the reading).
